resumo.en: Five animated scenes for Gloob's New Year campaign, with characters based on real influencers.

desafio.en:
Gloob wanted a New Year spot starring characters based on real influencers. They had to move like those people: their energy, their timing. I animated five scenes at Piloto TV, alongside Ivan Franco and Ullisses Soares.

The bar was rhythm: every action organic and expressive, and readable inside the channel's loud, saturated art direction.

processo.en:
In After Effects, the characters were cut-out puppets: every part on its own layer, animated by hand, keyframe by keyframe, with no rig. That kept every arc and overlap in my hands. For the acting, I filmed myself doing each action and used the footage as reference for weight and timing.

Then I worked scene by scene on sync: where an action lands, how long a pose holds, how a move settles. I kept the motion clean so it didn't fight the saturated palette set by art director Enio Vital.

resultado.en: Five scenes in one week, for a 30-second spot in the 2022 New Year campaign, on air on the Gloob channel from November 2021. Directed by Alexandre Chalabi, edited by Jéssica Rodrigues. Hand-keyed cut-outs and my own acting reference kept each character close to the person behind it.
